extraMeanings.en: to move soldiers or military equipment into position ready for action
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The general decided to deploy troops along the border.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: General, sınır boyunca birlikleri konuşlandırmaya karar verdi.

extraMeanings.en: to deal with a task or problem quickly and efficiently
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She dispatched the remaining paperwork in less than an hour.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kalan evrak işini bir saatten kısa sürede halletti.

extraMeanings.en: to let a part of the body rest loosely on something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He draped his arm over the back of the chair.

extraMeanings.en: to keep thinking or talking about something, especially something unpleasant
extraMeanings.exampleEn: There's no point in dwelling on your past mistakes.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Geçmişteki hatalarının üzerinde durmanın bir anlamı yok.

extraMeanings.en: to increase the level or amount of something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Too much salt can elevate your blood pressure.

extraMeanings.en: a set of clothes that are worn together to create a particular look
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She wore a stylish ensemble of a blazer, scarf and boots.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Blazer, atkı ve botlardan oluşan şık bir kombin giymişti.

extraMeanings.en: an organization that has a legal identity separate from its members
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The company is registered as a separate legal entity.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Şirket ayrı bir tüzel kişilik olarak kayıtlıdır.

extraMeanings.en: a division of geological time, a subdivision of a period
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Dinosaurs disappeared long before the current epoch.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Dinozorlar, içinde bulunduğumuz jeolojik devirden çok önce yok oldu.

extraMeanings.en: the management of relationships between countries by their governments
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The crisis was resolved through skillful diplomacy rather than force.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kriz, güç yerine ustaca yürütülen diplomasi ile çözüldü.
